name: Quo
description: QUO is a new phone for business. It comes with powerful calling, messaging, and a lightweight CRM.

Retrieve a specific message using its unique message ID.

Triggers when a call recording has finished.

Get all phone numbers, or only a specific user's numbers by providing their user ID.
Retrieve call records for a number or user, optionally filtered by date range or participant.
Triggered when a message sent from a selected phone number is successfully delivered to the recipient.
Retrieve conversations for a phone number or participant. Supports optional filters for user ID, date range, max results, and pagination.
List messages for a selected phone number or participant. Supports optional filters for user, date range, and pagination.
